BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby declare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land Nos. 1 : 194 of Block 1, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 720085, situated in the Village of Batugammana within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 130F - Guruhela in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Moneragala, in the District of Monaragala, in the Province of Uva, referred to in Notice No. 72/0251 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2294/24 of 22nd August, 2022 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. P. C. D. Sigera, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla, 13th June, 2024.
